stem:
There are 18 spoons in a drawer. This expression represents the number of forks in the same drawer.

2 \times 18

Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: There are 2 more spoons than forks in the drawer.

options.label: G
options.text: There are 2 more forks than spoons in the drawer.

options.label: H
options.text: There are 2 times as many forks as spoons in the drawer.

options.label: J
options.text: There are 2 times as many spoons as forks in the drawer.

difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding the multiplication expression represents forks, comparing quantities of spoons and forks, and interpreting statements accordingly.
